interface.longDescription: A central AMSoft plugin for reviewed agentic workflows. It bundles review-gated software delivery; business, writing, WordPress, and non-generative food-image workflows with researched adjustment and composition guidance, crop and perspective decision matrices, bounded four-corner perspective rectification, and previewed source-derived masks; protected DigitalOcean, Cloudflare, and Railway operations; and authenticated-encrypted configuration transfer.
